---
title: "olympics_explore"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(class)

olympics <- read_csv("athlete_events.csv")

olympics <- olympics |> filter (Year >= 1980)

olympicsF <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "F")
olympicsM <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "M")

olympicsF <- olympicsF |> filter(!is.na(Sport))
olympicsF <- olympicsF |> filter(!is.na(Age))
olympicsF <- olympicsF |> filter(!is.na(Weight))
olympicsF <- olympicsF |> filter(!is.na(Height))

olympicsF <- olympicsF |> mutate(across(.cols = c("Age", "Height", "Weight"), ~ (.x - min(.x)) / (max(.x) - min(.x))))
```

```{r}
olympicsF_train <- olympicsF |> slice_sample(n = 43580)
olympicsF_test <- anti_join(olympicsF, olympicsF_train)

olySmallTrain <- olympicsF_train |> select(Age, Weight, Height)

olySmallTest <- olympicsF_test |> select(Age, Weight, Height)

olyTrainCat <- olympicsF_train$Sport
olyTestCat <- olympicsF_test$Sport

knn_oly <- knn(train = olySmallTrain, test = olySmallTest, cl = olyTrainCat, k = 10)

tab <- table(knn_oly, olyTestCat)
tab

sum(diag(tab)) / sum(tab)
```
